description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF binds R0-00-WT-ISOLATION's queue tests_first suites (admit-resources-packet.spec.ts and fixture-prefix-registry.spec.ts, created by its tests-first commit c777ce8d; public-rate-limit.guard.spec.ts, extended for the namespaced public rate-limit keys). Every case that passed at the R0-35 head is required (59 cases); allowAdditionalCases is true so a later packet may add a case without editing this manifest, while a required case that is renamed, skipped, turned into a todo or deleted rejects the verdict, and a new skip or todo fails release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts until scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json explains it. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only worktree-isolation.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0 for every Release 0 manifest), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
